description: Port universe + inland yards for ZIM. Keys from zim_yards.geojson (CityYard). type is port (v3 secondary-scrape target) or inland (v3 main scrape). v3 = scrape inland, derive ports, secondary-scrape missing ports (see /synth.md). READ-ONLY: v3 only reads type. ZIM returns port names (portArrivalName) directly, so no location-code enrichment; zim_cities.json is flat (no explode). NOTES: (1) Newark, NJ is classified inland (not a port): the zim_cities entry for that yard is actually the NY/NJ port USNYC with shortPortName "New York, NY", which is NOT the yard key — as a port it would misalign the missing-ports diff/guard; as inland it is scraped directly and its (direct) New York, NY ocean leg still derives correctly. (2) All 11 port yards have shortPortName == key and are in utils.PORT_NAMES, so normalize_pod yields the coverage key. (3) yard set has Los Angeles (no Long Beach) and no PNW port, so any Long Beach/Seattle/Tacoma voyages appear only as derive-only distinct discharge ports. (4) origins Semarang and Karachi are not in zim_cities (ZIM does not cover them) and are auto-skipped.
